messages:
Sasha: Quick thread to build a 1-page customer-facing go-live checklist: onboarding health, renewal signals, caching/batching/streaming tips, and a tiny feedback loop. Keep it actionable.

Noah: From SRE: pick pragmatic SLOs for interactive features: p95 < 250ms, p99 < 800ms. Default tenant throttling: 25 rps. Circuit-break: open if error_rate > 4% for 1m. Recommend a warmup probe every 10-20m during ramp.

Ravi: Batch/cache rules for customers (short & usable):
- Very low traffic (<40 rps): batch_size 1-3.
- Moderate (40-180 rps): batch_size 6-14 + prefix prefill for top 20 prompts.
- Heavy (>180 rps): dynamic batching, or reserve a small warm pool.
Seq_len caveat: if median seq_len >512, halve batch sizes and watch GPU mem. Cache TTLs we suggest: conversation starters 2-15m, stable templates 2-12h.

Lia: Customer preflight checklist (to top the page):
1) Confirm warm pool enabled & capacity.
2) Upload 30 representative prompts/responses.
3) Check token caps and embedding settings.
4) Run synthetic probe and verify p95/p99 on dashboard.
5) Choose streaming when low-latency tail is critical.

Jamie: Renewal/AM quick playbook (red flags -> actions):
Red flags: 7-day drop in completions >18%, p99 spike >25%, >2 new tickets in 7d, survey <=3.
Actions: schedule triage within 48h, propose 2-week warm-pool trial, prepare cost/latency before/after caching numbers, gather 10 failing prompts for evals.

Sasha: Can we add a tiny risk score snippet AMs can use? Keep it very simple to read.

Ravi: Paste-friendly pseudo-score for the one-pager:
score = (p99_up_pct > 25 ? 3 : 0) + (usage_drop_7d ? 2 : 0) + (open_tickets > 2 ? 2 : 0) + (survey_low ? 3 : 0)
if score >= 7 -> HIGH RISK (AM: escalate).

Noah: Minimal warmup probe (bash) customers can run or we run from ops:
#!/bin/bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"openchat-7b","input":"warmup-check"}' | jq '.latency_ms'

Sasha: Ops-bot, any managed actions customers/AMs can call?

ops-bot: Managed warmup: `/run warmup-job --tenant <id> --profile rapid`. Logs: `/logs/warmups/<tenant_id>`. Tag: `warmup:managed`. Use console schedule or API.

Noah: Quick grep snippets for triage (ops/CS):
grep 'batch_error' /var/log/redwood/warmup.log | tail -n 80
jq -c '.events[] | select(.level=="error")' /var/log/redwood/tenant_<id>.json | tail -n 40
Also surface these metrics on the CS dashboard: p99_latency_ms, prefill_hit_rate, warmpool_util, retry_rate.

Lia: Feedback capture flow (AM steps):
1) Week-1 2-question pulse: latency (1-5), relevance (1-5).
2) If any <=3 -> open triage ticket + 30-min debug.
3) Attach 10 failing prompts/outputs to ticket for evals.

Jamie: Short Slack template AMs can use (one message):
Hey <Team> :wave: Quick go-live check: can you run this warmup probe and paste the p99? If >800ms or errors, well book a 30-min triage and offer a warm-pool trial. One-pager attached.

Sasha: Great thread. @Ravi will draft the one-pager PDF with these bullets and the risk snippet. @Lia will polish customer wording and the 2-question survey. @Noah will add the probe to ops repo and the CS dashboard tiles. Pin the PDF in #cs-runbooks and well do a 15-min AM walkthrough next Wed. :rocket:
